info.title: Shotl MAAS
info.description:
Shotl MaaS API permits integrating demand-responsive transport services provided by Shotl with a third party platform offering multi-modal mobility, as a MaaS operator or a journey planner.

Mirroring the functions of the Shotl App for passengers available in iOS and Android markets, it permits to estimate times and book rides within any of the areas where Shotl is currently offering transportation.

post.description: All endpoints are authorized by the standard jwt. It follows the recommendations from RFC 7519: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7519

type_of_assistance.example: Need personal assistance from the driver.

post.description: When you want to schedule a new ride, you need to create a draft in order to accept the conditions of pickup and drop-off. It's not definitive, but it guarantees the specified availability. Petitions for more than 15 days are not alowed.

passenger_fare_type.description: Fare types and number of passenger that are involved in. The sum has to match the number of passengers. Otherwise the request will be rejected.

desired_pickup_location.description: Location where the user wants to be picked up

desired_dropoff_location.description: Location where the user wants to be taken

passengers.description: Information about passengers count. It could be regular or wheelchair.

desired_pickup_time.description: Time when the user wants to be picked up. Only if type is schedule_ride, otherwise will be ignored. Must be within the next 15 natural days considering the day when the petition is made (petition_time) as day 1.

The detail of a ride. Please note that a unconfirmed ride (draft) may be removed from our system if it hasn't been confirmed after a time (time specified by configuration)

put.summary: Create or update a ride for a specific area
put.description: The creation of rides through this endpoint is limited to final status. Otherwise, you can use the /rides endpoint.

pickup_stop_id.description: Scheduled location where was picked up the passenger

dropoff_stop_id.description: Stop where was taken the passenger

petition_time.description: When the user did the petition

user_expected_pickup_time.description: When the user expected to pick up. Unix timestamp

user_expected_dropoff_time.description: When the user expected to dropoff. Unix timestamp

effective_pickup_time.description: When the user was picked up. Unix timestamp. If it's empty and the status is FINISHED, it will take the value from the user_expected_pickup_time

effective_dropoff_time.description: When the user was taken to its destiny. Unix timestamp. If it's empty and the status is FINISHED, it will take the value from the user_expected_dropoff_time

confirmation_time.description: When the user confirmated the ride

cancellation_time.description: When the user cancelled the ride, if did

noshow_time.description: When the user cancelled the ride, if did

passengers.description: Information about passengers count. It could be regular or wheelchair.

post.description: A ride can be cancelled at any moment if the status is scheduled, driver_launched or user_launched. Otherwise, it won't be possible.

get.description: Shotl algoritms may change the assigned vehicle at any moment if they considers it more efficient. It's recommended to check it periodically. On the other hand, it can be null if there is no vehicle assigned

get.summary: Get hourly distance metrics for vehicles
get.description: Returns hourly distance information for specified vehicles in a given area and date. If no vehicles are specified, returns data for all vehicles.

parameters.description: Date to get metrics for in YYYY-MM-DD format

parameters.description: List of vehicle IDs to filter by. If not provided, returns data for all vehicles.
